title: POV one more episode

scenes.text: POV: you said "just one more episode" 😭
Episode 1: "ok this is the last one"

scenes.say: Your alarm rings in twelve minutes.

caption: it was NOT just one more episode 💀
sound: a calm, lo-fi trending sound at low volume
why: Universal relatable situation, escalating structure, punchline at the end makes people rewatch.
